description: This source file appears to implement the core logic for a plugin named LinearPlaybackControl within the WPEFramework. It includes initialization and deinitialization routines, uses configuration parameters, manages some demuxer and file listener objects, and sets up plugin metadata. The file references external headers and classes related to demuxers and configuration, indicating it manages media playback control functionalities.
